list.name: table_name
list.label: table_name
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT table_name FROM recstore.metrics ORDER BY table_name

targets.rawSql: SELECT toStartOfInterval(toDateTime(intDiv(timestamp_us, 1000000)), INTERVAL 1 MINUTE) AS t, count() AS samples FROM recstore.metrics WHERE $__timeFilter(toDateTime(intDiv(timestamp_us, 1000000))) AND table_name IN ($table_name) GROUP BY t ORDER BY t

SELECT toStartOfInterval(toDateTime(intDiv(timestamp_us, 1000000)), INTERVAL 1 MINUTE) AS t, metric_name, quantile(0.5)(metric_value) AS p50, quantile(0.99)(metric_value) AS p99 FROM recstore.metrics WHERE $__timeFilter(toDateTime(intDiv(timestamp_us, 1000000))) AND metric_name IN ('duration_us', 'latency_us', 'recstore_us', 'recserver_us') GROUP BY t, metric_name ORDER BY t

SELECT toDateTime(intDiv(timestamp_us, 1000000)) AS time, table_name, unique_id, metric_name, metric_value, source FROM recstore.metrics WHERE $__timeFilter(toDateTime(intDiv(timestamp_us, 1000000))) ORDER BY timestamp_us DESC LIMIT 200
